notes.title: Episode 4 Released!
notes.content:
This update allows players to join Ari and Zoe on their 4th time-traveling adventure through the industrial revolution! 
What's new?
[list]
[*] New Episode 4 content, including new art, RAD mechanics and story!
[*] Updates to the RAD in previous episodes, including expanding the Scene View!
[/list]
